references.text: The people ask the same question about how his eyes were opened and refer to Jesus' action with the word 'made' (ἐποίησεν).
The healed man uses the same word for Jesus' action ('made' / ἐποίησεν) when he confirms that God has never heard of anyone opening the eyes of a blind person.
The neighbors ask the same question about how his eyes were opened and use identical wording about 'making' (ἐποίησεν) something to him.
